notes.title: Temple Hunters price changes and continued development!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are back with some new announcements. For the past year, I was occupied with my University halting the work on Temple Hunters but now I have time again to continue developing it. Now that development has started again, I am very much looking forward to any feedback or new suggestions! So feel free to fill the forums with your ideas to make the game more fun! Also, map suggestions/ideas are greatly appreciated. 

Price changes!
Furthermore, in the past and as of recent I have received a lot of valuable feedback for Temple Hunters some of it for gameplay, awesome ideas from the community and more. One of which was also pricing. After surveying more around we have decided to change the pricing of Tempel Hunters from $10.99, to $3.99. We feel like this is a good decision so we can grow a more active player base for the multiplayer modes. As for co-op/single player, this may not have much of an effect but it would be easier for you and your friends to pick up the game and play together.

When does this take effect?
Temple Hunters will be discounted next week, and the price change will be official following that week (02/10/2023).

What about everyone who bought the game beforehand?
For everyone who purchased the game before this recent price change, we will receive a reward in the game which will be worked on so stay tuned for that! :)

Will Temple Hunters increase in price again?
Over time when more content gets added, the price might increase again.

Thank you all for reading this announcement. I hope everyone is doing fantastic. It's good to be back. 
And as always, I will see you out there, hunting for treasure :)

notes.title: Update Regarding development and small delays.
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone, it's been a while since I've updated anything regarding development but does not fear, I still have a lot planned for Temple Hunters in the future.

A lot has happened in the past few months where I've had to spend less time on the game sadly due to my University projects, My final project (as I'm graduating soon) and more. 

Also one of the most painful things that happened was that the drive on which I stored a lot of important files for Temple Hunters, has crashed. BUT Fear not! Only some Audio data was lost which is more easily replaced. It's still a blow but I will be able to fix this. Furthermore, I've been looking at implementing new texture and vegetation to Temple Hunters and have been working on a new implementation that will be coming in the future and will enhance the game visually.

Development is still planned but will most likely continue at a later time as I am fully focussing on my graduation project right now. Once that's finished I will be able to regain focus on developing updates for Temple Hunters so stay tuned! I have a lot more ideas and fun things planned for future updates so stay tuned!

Thank you all for reading, and I hope to see you out there, hunting for treasure!

notes.title: The "Game Feel" update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, after a week of work, listening to your feedback, and testing we are now releasing the brand new Game Feel Update! We haven't had the time yet to make an official devlog video because we've been working so hard on the update, but we are eager to hear everyone's response to the new update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050955/9aed292a2d52bc2bd1ba2a18e26338380afd94d3.jpg

So what's new?

 Player motion has been refined giving a smoother feel to the camera and the player's movement.
 Aiming of the rifle has been improved, allowing the camera to move to the point of where the player is aiming, to give the player an advantage over AI, and allowing you to spot your enemies earlier!
 You will now automatically respawn on death, you will no longer have to press "Space" manually :)
 Upon a kill or treasure claim, the screen will now visually show that you've gotten +100(or another amount) of score!
 The health bar is now animated, when losing health it will visually be represented, the same goes for gaining.
 When holding a shovel near a digging site, a new Icon will appear on the right bottom of the screen to show how much of the treasure has been dug up yet, to indicate the digging progress!
 Animations have been improved to look less like "Sliding on ice".
 We have started work on adding controller support (Xbox One) (Driving, walking, aiming, and shooting, now works for the controller, but it is still in its early testing phase so reloading, choosing a weapon etc, will still require you to use your keyboard).


Bugfixes

 Aiming inside the Abydos Temple will no longer clip the camera through the roof.
 You are now able to aim through the pillars and other objects.
 Other camera clipping bugs have been fixed.
 You are now able to pick up treasure again.
 We've started work on Optimizing the Peruvian Jungle map for lower-end systems. So it should work better now.
 And a whole bunch of other bug fixes.


I hope that the brand new aiming system will bring joy to all of you and improve your experience playing Temple Hunters. I appreciate all the support and amazing feedback from all of you. The next update will be the "Abydos Expanded" update so stay tuned for that!

Thank you all for reading this update, and I hope to see you out there, Hunting for Treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Co-op update is here!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! After a long time of working hard on Temple Hunters we're now ready to release the 1st part of the co-op update! This update includes a new co-op mode, a new map, AI improvements, and more!

What's new!

 A new co-op mode, play with 4 friends (or strangers) together!
 A new map called the Abydos Temple.
 First edition of story elements, find out what happened in the temple and solve the clues given to you.
 AI now has a spotting mechanic, visually and audible represented.
 When the AI now calls backup, you will hear the siren go off.
 AI is now less OP after having gone through intense training with the Stormtroopers, meaning they will now hit you less often :)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39050955/50335904aab96d5ca8c71dc57d88113bb5869a5a.png
A screenshot of the Abydos Temple entrance.

A few other tweaks and effects have been added to the game for you all to explore. I am very excited for you all to get your hands on the update and hear your feedback. If you're up to date with the roadmap, our next update will work on Game feel making everything feel more smoothened and refined so stay tuned for that!

Thank you all for reading this update and I hope to see you all out there, hunting for treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Release Date & Devlog #6!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The time has come after over a year of development, feedback, and excitement to Release Temple Hunters to the public! We have decided to release Temple Hunters on the 21st of July 2021 (21/7/2021) to the public as an Early Access title! Early Access means that we will continue development while the player base will be able to get their hands on the game and give their feedback and of course most important, enjoy the game :).

The Price of the game will be $10.99 or €8,99 BUT the game will launch at a 10% discount for those who decide to buy the game during the launch. Like we have mentioned before, as the game keeps growing and developing, Temple Hunters may increase in price based on new features and content that we are going to add to the game.

Devlog #6
During the Steam Festival, we have had a LOT of feedback and I am very happy to have met all of you and heard your thoughts. We have not been sitting still with your feedback and started fixing numerous of bugs and adding new features to the game. Here's a full list of everything that has happened.


 The Abydos Temple (Co-op mode/map) has now further been developed and is expected to be released this week!
 Localization has been added for the in-game menu's supporting English, Dutch, French, German and Spanish for now.
 The Jungle map now has a new spawn region for the German side and has new sites and temples ready for discovery!
 A huge number of bug fixes and optimizations.
 A new Victory/Defeat screen has been added.
 The player will not receive XP for killing and capturing points. XP will allow the player to Level up and in the future unlock new perks etc!
 Added option to Toggle Aim by clicking (no longer need to hold).
 Added invert mouse option to rotate the camera.
 Added Visible Damage effects when the player gets hit.
 Player names are now visible above friends and enemies.
 Enemy now shows up on the map when they shoot (not constantly but now and then) for you to track their movements.
 Allies now show up on the map as well!
 Cars will now start Automatically upon entering them.
 AI no longer shoots Invisible bullets
 And more!


[previewyoutube=juHyuekWKRc;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you all for reading and watching this announcement/devlog. It's been so far an amazing ride with lots of excitement, joy, and hard work. And I can't wait for the release date and to keep adding more and amazing/fun features to Temple Hunters!

That will be all for this huge announcement! And I hope to see you all out there, Hunting for Treasure!
- Niels

 AI and Players now bleed and visually show they're hit with an animation.
 The Win screen has been changed, now properly showing the winning team and in better coloring. (The game win screen is not final and more changes and updates will be made).
 A Huge list of bug fixes which can all be seen on our Trello.
 Other UI Improvements.
 We have added a small button for you to join our Discord group in the main menu, which will allow you to stay up-to-date with development!
 Levers now have a glow animation when you're in range to interact with them.
 The interaction UI has been improved with a better visual design.


Thank you all for coming along on this amazing journey. I am very grateful to have met you all in the past days, and for having heard all the great idea's and feedback you've all given me to make Temple Hunters even better! I look forward to meeting more of you today during the Dev Livestream, and at any other moment when we're playing the game.

That will be all for this Patch! And I hope to see you all out there, Hunting for Treasure!
- Niels

notes.title: Release date Q1 2021!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

The year 2020 has been very exciting for us. Lots of progress was made on Temple Hunters and NielsDev itself! We've grown our follower base, starting to get noticed more, and listened to all your awesome feedback on the game! 

But 2020 has also been very challenging, due to COVID-19, there sadly have been some delays. First off, it straight to the point. We've pushed back Temple Hunters release to Q1 2021. Why you may ask?
We want to release our game and make sure it's fun to play at a good quality level. Even though the game is already playable, and our 1st big map has already been finished. We would like to Launch our game with a 2nd awesome map, and some new and fun mechanics and features for everyone!

We would like to thank you all for reading, and for waiting a little bit more. It will definitely be worth it :)

- Niels

If you would like to stay up to date with development, then please join our discord.
